answer: Random VRF beacon spot-checks plus compute heartbeats starve sybil swarms. Each round the beacon challenges every identity, which must reply with a heartbeat in minutes or be slashed. Each forged identity costs 0.4 vCPU-hours per round, so a 100-bot nebula burns 40 vCPU-hours per round, and costs spiral upward with every added identity. Honest agents run nonstop, so heartbeats are nearly free; with sybils off the ridge, rewards stay undiluted.
